title: Face
description: The characteristic values of one card face. A layout either places these fields on the card record or groups them under face names. The layout schema closes the property set with unevaluatedProperties. Referenced from card/normal.schema.json.

mana_cost.description: The mana-symbol IDs that make up this face's mana cost. Left out when the face has no mana cost.

color_indicator.description: The color indicator on this face. Each value is the id of a color in data/card/component/color.json. Color itself is derived from the mana cost, this indicator, and characteristic-defining abilities (CR 105.2).

flavor_text.description: The flavor text in English. Left out when the face prints none.

power.description: Power, when the face prints one. Left out when the face prints none.

toughness.description: Toughness, when the face prints one. Left out when the face prints none.

loyalty.description: Starting loyalty, when the face prints one. Left out when the face prints none.

defense.description: Defense, when the face prints one. Left out when the face prints none.

hand_modifier.description: The hand modifier, when the face has one. Left out when the face has none.

life_modifier.description: The life modifier, when the face has one. Left out when the face has none.

word_id.description: The id of a value in a list under data/card/component/ whose value is a word.

symbol_id.description: The ID of a mana symbol in data/card/component/mana_symbol.json, written without braces. Generic numeric symbols use the number itself as the ID (for example, 2); the shape also allows symbols such as ½.

printed_number.description: A number printed on the face, or the printed form when it is not a fixed number, such as * or 1+*.
